provenance.note: Plan-derived names/coverage retain plan provenance. Original questions and selective draft procedures; no qualified review.

domains.coverage_nl: Doel, tijd, budget, ervaring, vestiging en betrokken personen.
domains.applicability_condition: Any intake or changed founder constraints. This is a relevance prompt, not a legal applicability conclusion; missing context remains unknown.

questions.text: What outcome and available time are actually reported?
What budget, experience, location and people are known or unknown?
